objective: Wire ctDNA tumor fraction (TF) into the resistance matrix: define a calibrated TF -> resistance-probability mapping that would replace the current WIRED_PROGNOSTIC_ONLY_V1 lock. THIS IS A DESIGN SPEC ONLY — no framework code is modified in this run.

tier1_direct.source: BriTROC-1 plasma sWGS (EGA-controlled, same study EGAD00001011049 family)
tier1_direct.status: Only TIER1-direct route pairing per-patient longitudinal ctDNA-TF with a resistance label. EGA-controlled; the tumour-DNA arm is now live-entitled, but the PLASMA/ctDNA arm entitlement must be confirmed separately.
tier1_direct.note: Removing the WIRED_PROGNOSTIC_ONLY_V1 lock REQUIRES controlled longitudinal ctDNA data — no open cohort provides it.

tier3_prognostic_only.source: MITO16a / Paracchini et al. ESMO Open 2026;11(3):106087, n=167
tier3_prognostic_only.note: prognostic-only, already in registry; cannot calibrate a resistance-probability mapping alone

calibration_spec.input_feature: ctDNA tumor fraction (TF) at a defined on-treatment timepoint (e.g. ichorCNA TF from plasma sWGS, or MRD-style variant-allele-fraction-derived TF).
calibration_spec.recommended_model: monotone calibration: isotonic regression OR a monotone-constrained logistic link p_resist = sigmoid(a + b*logit(TF_normalized)), with b constrained >= 0 (higher TF -> higher/equal resistance probability). Isotonic is preferred when n is small and the TF->risk shape is uncertain but assumed monotone non-decreasing.
calibration_spec.why_monotone: Biological prior: higher residual/rising on-treatment ctDNA-TF reflects greater viable tumor burden / poorer platinum clearance -> higher resistance risk. Monotonicity guards against overfitting spurious non-monotone wiggles at small n.
calibration_spec.normalization: TF logit-transformed after flooring at assay LOD; standardize within-assay to control for platform sensitivity (sWGS vs targeted).
calibration_metrics: ROC-AUC for the resistant vs sensitive split
calibration_spec.validation: leave-one-patient-out or nested CV given expected small n; report calibration curve with 95% CI.
calibration_spec.longitudinal_extension: for serial TF, use TF trajectory features (nadir TF, TF slope over first ~100d, time-to-TF-clearance) as inputs — parallels the KELIM early-kinetics logic (W1) but on ctDNA instead of CA-125.

matrix_integration_design.current_state: ctDNA axis is WIRED_PROGNOSTIC_ONLY_V1 (contributes prognostic signal but NOT a calibrated resistance probability into predict_resistance).
matrix_integration_design.proposed_change: replace the prognostic-only lock with the calibrated p_resist(TF) above, entering the resistance matrix as an additional evidence channel with an explicit weight; combine with genomic (Sig7), clinical (true-PFI), and CA-125-kinetic (KELIM) channels via the existing ranker.
matrix_integration_design.governance_note: This is governance-sensitive per user's custom instructions. NO code is changed in this run. Unlocking WIRED_PROGNOSTIC_ONLY_V1 must be an explicit, separately-authorized decision AND requires the TIER1 controlled ctDNA data to actually calibrate the mapping. Until both hold, the lock stays.
prerequisites_to_unlock: confirmed entitlement + pull of BriTROC-1 (or equivalent) longitudinal plasma ctDNA-TF paired with resistance labels
fitted + validated monotone calibration meeting calibration-slope/Brier acceptance
explicit user authorization to modify predict_resistance
